verdict.rationale: Perplexity has official store listings on both the Apple App Store and Google Play. The iOS listing documents a broad feature set: Pro Search and Deep Research, Assistant, Labs, Voice, cited sources, Library, Discover and thread follow-ups. The Android listing confirms a free app that syncs across devices and uses top AI models. Missing for 10: detailed Android feature parity documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile app quality.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can use full-featured official mobile apps for iOS and Android

citations.quote: Perplexity Pro Search & Deep Research: Guided AI search for deeper exploration.
Assistant: Draft emails, schedule appointments, book reservations, and more.
Perplexity Labs: Bring your reports and projects to life faster than ever before.
Voice: Instant, up-to-date answers whether you type or say it.
Your Library: More than search history, it's a curation of your discoveries.
This free app syncs across devices and leverages the power of the top AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and more.
